review.note: Strada Mărășești retains its explicit two lanes. Measures the two live travel lanes between visible kerb parking bands; excludes parked-car bands, sidewalks and property forecourts. The full approximately 530 m source way was inspected; local centre-line offset and roadside parking vary, so constant asymmetric extents are not asserted.

measurement.scope: travel carriageway excluding parking and sidewalks

review.note: Narrow private gravel drive, one physical vehicle track. Excludes the broad pale northern parking/forecourt apron and vegetated shoulders. The mapped centre line sits approximately 1–2 m south of the identifiable travel strip at central calipers. Width is measured independently; source XY stays exact. A nonnegative constant left/right pair cannot faithfully fit that offset, so no asymmetric extents are applied.

measurement.scope: travel carriageway excluding parking and sidewalks

review.note: Leaf-off independent aerial imagery reveals a continuous narrow concrete vehicle track west of the house. Excludes the western coach-parking forecourt, eastern house yard and adjacent vegetation. Width varies from approximately 2.6 to 3.8 m; the median and explicit uncertainty describe one physical vehicle track, not two full lanes. Raw width/lanes are absent. Source node positions remain exact. Local registration/centre-line offset varies, so no constant asymmetric extents are imposed. The 2021 Wayback release is a publication date, not a known acquisition date; leaf-on 2023 and leaf-off 2019 releases were separately inspected for continuity.
